title: eludite.debug.start input
description: Debug > Start Debugging (F5) or Start Without Debugging (Ctrl+F5): run the startup project's built program (`dotnet` on its DLL) with its launchSettings.json profile's arguments and environment, under the netcoredbg debug adapter or, without debugging, with its output in the Debug Console. Build the project first; this command does not build. Refused while a session is running (use eludite.debug.continue to resume a break).

project.description: The project to run: its path (absolute or relative to the solution folder) or its name as the Workspace window shows it. Default: the startup project, the solution's first executable project.

debug.description: False runs without the debugger (Ctrl+F5). Default true.

profile.description: The launchSettings.json profile to use. Default: the first profile whose commandName is Project.

wait_ms.description: How long to wait for the debuggee to break, exit or settle before answering, in milliseconds. From the UI the command never waits; from another thread (an agent) the default is 5000.
